paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 29b; but in Nedarim 74a the statement appears without the words “bar Ahavah.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Both William Davidson digital passages, Yevamot 29b and Nedarim 74a, fully write Rabbi Ami. The former includes the parenthesized patronymic bar Ahavah; the latter does not. Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav Ami, retained here.

The whole Davidson Yevamot 29b and Nedarim 74a paragraphs fully write Rabbi Ami; the former has parenthesized bar Ahavah and the latter omits it. Hyman’s fully written Rav heading and the current note remain unchanged, without a title harmonization or an identity admission.
